Gigantic banana-yellow slug with a maw comprised of multiple mandibles. Slimy.

AC 15, HP 59, ATK 2 bite (near) +7 (3d8), MV double near (burrow, fly), S +5, D +5, C +5, I -3, W +4, Ch +3, AL C, LV 12

Horrific Appearance. Mortal creatures looking directly at Thuskchoon, WIS 15+ or INT cursed, INT drops to 1 1. On success, immune for 24 hours.

Pure Evil. Only damaged by cold iron or magical sources. Immune to acid.

Swallow. On a natural attack roll of 18-20, target is swallowed. Total darkness inside and 2d10 damage per round. Thuskchoon regurgitates all swallowed if dealt at least 20 damage in one round to the inside of its gullet.

Tar. Within close of Thuskchoon and the places he's moved, DEX 15+ or stuck, entangled for 1d4 rounds.

Shadowfinder Complete Bestiary
